title: Kiln data pack "registry" section (generated)
description: Generated from schema/registry/*.json by tools/registrygen/registrygen.py. Do not edit. Edits of Kiln registries by stage: every mod's add, then every mod's alter, then every mod's final (later in load order wins and is reported; relative operations stack; exclusive keeps the strict rule; yield applies only where no earlier writer set the field). Experimental (KILNX031): read by the registry stage from the release that wires it (docs/kiln/modding/registries/README.md).

select.description: Which entries: an id, a case-insensitive glob over ids (game:material_*), or an old debug-name selector, as a plain string or as {"id": ...}; the object form also takes where: conditions on the entry's fields; has / hasNot: traits.

op.description: A value (set), or relative operations evaluated as data packs evaluate them: r = clamp(v * mul + add, min, max), then raiseOnly / lowerOnly against v.

list.description: A list operation: clear, append, remove (values to take out), replace (the whole list).
